page.layout: Running head at top: "Fasti Consulares" with page number 302 at top left. One central framed table of consul names, four lines per year, with the year printed in the right margin beside each group, plus a last "Iidem." row at the bottom right. Left margin holds five italic marginal notes beside the rows for 1565, 1566, 1568, 1570 and 1571.

note.i: Præsidium militum in urbem Gro-ning. inductum.
Comes Arembergius cum Hispanis suis cæsus ad cœnobium Hilligerlæum a Ludovico Com. Nass. Groninga ab eodem obsessa, sed adventu Albani liberata; exercitus ipsius Iemgumi concisus.
Arx Groningæ extrui cæpta ab Hispanicis.

page.notes: Consul names are copied as printed. "Heiman Clant." (1567) is hard to read at the scan resolution and may be "Herman" or "Heiman". "Iohan Wifering." (1566) is printed with a final "g" and not a period. The years 1565–1572 sit in the right margin at the middle of each group of rows, so they are attached to the first line of each group here. The bottom "Iidem." is printed at the lower right, under the frame, and is italic. The dot at top right and the grey marks on the left edge are not printed text and are left out. No catchword or signature is printed.
